title.en: SAT R&W: Words in Context: signal words and positive or negative meaning
title.uz: SAT R&W: Words in Context — yoʻnalish soʻzlari va soʻzning ijobiy yoki salbiy maʼnosi
title.ru: SAT R&W: Words in Context — слова-сигналы и положительная или отрицательная окраска

body.en:
Lesson 1 found the clue. This lesson reads the signal words that tell you which way the blank goes, and then the charge of the missing word.
Two kinds of signal:
1. Contrast (however, although, yet, but, despite, while): the blank goes against the idea before it.
2. Cause and result (because, since, so, therefore, as a result): the blank goes the same way as the idea before it.
Then mark the charge: is the missing word positive (+) or negative (−)? Decide before you look at the options.
Example: "Although the road was rough, the ride was surprisingly ______." Signal: although, so the blank goes against "rough" (−). Charge: +. Your word: smooth.
body.uz:
1-darsda ishorani topdik. Bu darsda boʻsh joy qaysi tomonga ketishini koʻrsatadigan yoʻnalish soʻzlarini, keyin esa tushib qolgan soʻzning ohangini oʻqiymiz.
Yoʻnalish soʻzlari ikki xil:
1. Qarama-qarshilik (however, although, yet, but, despite, while): boʻsh joy oldingi fikrga zid boradi.
2. Sabab va natija (because, since, so, therefore, as a result): boʻsh joy oldingi fikr bilan bir tomonga boradi.
Keyin ohangni belgilang: tushib qolgan soʻz ijobiymi (+) yoki salbiymi (−)? Buni variantlarga qarashdan oldin hal qiling.
Misol: «Although the road was rough, the ride was surprisingly ______.» Yoʻnalish soʻzi: although, demak, boʻsh joy «rough» (notekis, −) ga zid. Ohang: +. Sizning soʻzingiz: smooth (ravon).
body.ru:
В уроке 1 мы искали подсказку. В этом уроке разбираем слова-сигналы, которые показывают, в какую сторону ведёт пропуск, а затем — окраску пропущенного слова.
Сигналы бывают двух видов:
1. Контраст (however, although, yet, but, despite, while): пропуск идёт против мысли перед ним.
2. Причина и следствие (because, since, so, therefore, as a result): пропуск идёт в ту же сторону, что и мысль перед ним.
Затем отметьте окраску: пропущенное слово положительное (+) или отрицательное (−)? Решите это до того, как смотреть на варианты.
Пример: «Although the road was rough, the ride was surprisingly ______.» Сигнал: although, значит, пропуск идёт против «rough» (неровная, −). Окраска: +. Ваше слово: smooth (плавная).

body.en:
Worked example: "The first cake Malika baked came out flat and dry. Because she measured everything carefully the second time, her next cake was ______."
1. Signal: because (cause), so the blank goes the same way as "measured everything carefully".
2. Charge: +.
3. Your word: good, light and soft.
Now you: "The website of the hotel showed bright, spacious rooms with a view of the mountains. When the Rashidov family arrived, however, their room was ______: two narrow beds filled it almost completely, and the only window faced a brick wall."
1. Signal: however (contrast), so the blank goes against "bright, spacious".
2. Charge: −.
3. Your word: small and crowded. Which option means that?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The first cake Malika baked came out flat and dry. Because she measured everything carefully the second time, her next cake was ______.»
1. Yoʻnalish soʻzi: because (sabab), demak, boʻsh joy «measured everything carefully» (hammasini diqqat bilan oʻlchadi) bilan bir tomonga boradi.
2. Ohang: +.
3. Sizning soʻzingiz: yaxshi, yengil va yumshoq.
Endi siz: «The website of the hotel showed bright, spacious rooms with a view of the mountains. When the Rashidov family arrived, however, their room was ______: two narrow beds filled it almost completely, and the only window faced a brick wall.»
1. Yoʻnalish soʻzi: however (qarama-qarshilik), demak, boʻsh joy «bright, spacious» (yorugʻ, keng) ga zid.
2. Ohang: −.
3. Sizning soʻzingiz: kichik va tor. Qaysi variant shuni bildiradi?
body.ru:
Разбор: «The first cake Malika baked came out flat and dry. Because she measured everything carefully the second time, her next cake was ______.»
1. Сигнал: because (причина), значит, пропуск идёт в ту же сторону, что и «measured everything carefully» (всё тщательно отмерила).
2. Окраска: +.
3. Ваше слово: удачный, лёгкий и мягкий.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The website of the hotel showed bright, spacious rooms with a view of the mountains. When the Rashidov family arrived, however, their room was ______: two narrow beds filled it almost completely, and the only window faced a brick wall.»
1. Сигнал: however (контраст), значит, пропуск идёт против «bright, spacious» (светлые, просторные).
2. Окраска: −.
3. Ваше слово: маленький и тесный. Какой вариант означает именно это?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
1. Negatives flip the charge. Not, never, hardly, far from and anything but turn the blank around. In "After the long winter, the garden was far from ______: weeds covered every bed", the weeds are −, but far from flips it, so the missing word is +: tidy.
2. Two signals in one text. Follow every signal up to the blank, not just the first one. In "The trip was long; still, nobody complained, because the views were ______", still turns against "long", and because goes the same way as "nobody complained": the blank is +.
Test your answer: put it in the blank and read the whole text again.
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Inkor ohangni teskari qiladi. Not, never, hardly, far from va anything but boʻsh joyni teskari tomonga buradi. «After the long winter, the garden was far from ______: weeds covered every bed.» gapida begona oʻtlar (−) bor, lekin far from teskari qiladi, shuning uchun tushib qolgan soʻz ijobiy (+): tidy (ozoda).
2. Bitta matnda ikkita yoʻnalish soʻzi. Faqat birinchisini emas, boʻsh joygacha boʻlgan har bir yoʻnalish soʻzini kuzating. «The trip was long; still, nobody complained, because the views were ______.» gapida still «long» ga zid buradi, because esa «nobody complained» bilan bir tomonga boradi: boʻsh joy +.
Javobingizni tekshiring: uni boʻsh joyga qoʻyib, butun matnni qayta oʻqing.
body.ru:
Осторожно, две ловушки.
1. Отрицание переворачивает окраску. Not, never, hardly, far from и anything but разворачивают пропуск. В «After the long winter, the garden was far from ______: weeds covered every bed» сорняки — это −, но far from переворачивает, поэтому пропущенное слово +: tidy (ухоженный).
2. Два сигнала в одном тексте. Следите за каждым сигналом до самого пропуска, а не только за первым. В «The trip was long; still, nobody complained, because the views were ______» still поворачивает против «long», а because идёт в ту же сторону, что и «nobody complained»: пропуск +.
Проверьте ответ: вставьте его в пропуск и перечитайте весь текст.

title.en: SAT R&W: Words in Context: the precise shade of a word
title.uz: SAT R&W: Words in Context — soʻzning aniq tusi: kuchi va munosabati
title.ru: SAT R&W: Words in Context — точный оттенок слова: сила и отношение

body.en:
Sometimes every option goes the right way and has the right charge. Then precision decides: the best word matches how strong the text is and what attitude it shows.
Ask two questions:
1. How strong? Near-synonyms differ in degree: concerned, worried, alarmed; like, love, adore; damp, wet, soaked.
2. What attitude? Two words can name the same fact with a different feeling: thrifty (careful with money, +) or stingy (unwilling to spend, −); confident (+) or arrogant (−).
Match both to the evidence: a small problem takes a mild word, a crisis a strong one; praise takes a positive word.
Example: "The test results were slightly lower than last year, so the head teacher was ______." A slight drop takes a mild word: concerned, not alarmed.
body.uz:
Baʼzan hamma variant toʻgʻri tomonga boradi va ohangi ham toʻgʻri. Unda aniqlik hal qiladi: eng yaxshi soʻz matnning kuchiga va undagi munosabatga mos keladi.
Oʻzingizga ikkita savol bering:
1. Qanchalik kuchli? Maʼnodosh soʻzlar darajasi bilan farq qiladi: concerned, worried, alarmed (biroz xavotirda, xavotirda, vahimada); like, love, adore; damp, wet, soaked (biroz nam, hoʻl, shalabbo).
2. Qanday munosabat? Ikki soʻz bir faktni turli his bilan aytishi mumkin: thrifty (tejamkor, +) yoki stingy (xasis, −); confident (oʻziga ishongan, +) yoki arrogant (takabbur, −).
Ikkalasini dalilga moslang: kichik muammoga yumshoq soʻz, katta muammoga kuchli soʻz; maqtovga ijobiy soʻz.
Misol: «The test results were slightly lower than last year, so the head teacher was ______.» Ozgina pasayish yumshoq soʻzni talab qiladi: concerned, alarmed emas.
body.ru:
Иногда все варианты идут в нужную сторону и с нужной окраской. Тогда решает точность: лучшее слово совпадает с силой текста и с отношением в нём.
Задайте два вопроса:
1. Насколько сильно? Близкие слова различаются степенью: concerned, worried, alarmed (обеспокоен, встревожен, в панике); like, love, adore; damp, wet, soaked (влажный, мокрый, промокший насквозь).
2. Какое отношение? Два слова могут назвать один факт с разным чувством: thrifty (бережливый, +) или stingy (скупой, −); confident (уверенный, +) или arrogant (заносчивый, −).
Сверьте и то и другое с текстом: маленькой проблеме — мягкое слово, большой — сильное; похвале — положительное.
Пример: «The test results were slightly lower than last year, so the head teacher was ______.» Небольшое снижение требует мягкого слова: concerned, а не alarmed.

body.en:
Worked example: "Kamron has a grandmother who mends old clothes and keeps every jar, yet she happily pays for books for all her grandchildren. The family calls her ______, and they mean it kindly."
1. Meaning: careful with money.
2. Attitude: she spends gladly on books, and the family means it kindly: positive.
3. Match: thrifty (+) fits. Stingy (−) has the right meaning but the wrong attitude.
Now you: "In her review of the school play, Mahliyo praised the ______ performance of the lead actor: in the final scene he spoke with complete calm and certainty, never once glancing at the prompter, and the audience believed every word."
1. Meaning: calm and certain.
2. Attitude: she praised it, so positive.
3. Which option is certain and positive?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Kamron has a grandmother who mends old clothes and keeps every jar, yet she happily pays for books for all her grandchildren. The family calls her ______, and they mean it kindly.»
1. Maʼno: pulni ehtiyot qiladi.
2. Munosabat: kitobga xursand boʻlib pul sarflaydi, oila buni mehr bilan aytadi: ijobiy.
3. Solishtiring: thrifty (+) mos. Stingy (−) maʼnosi toʻgʻri, lekin munosabati notoʻgʻri.
Endi siz: «In her review of the school play, Mahliyo praised the ______ performance of the lead actor: in the final scene he spoke with complete calm and certainty, never once glancing at the prompter, and the audience believed every word.»
1. Maʼno: xotirjam va oʻziga ishongan.
2. Munosabat: u maqtagan, demak, ijobiy.
3. Qaysi variant ham oʻziga ishonchni, ham ijobiy munosabatni bildiradi?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Kamron has a grandmother who mends old clothes and keeps every jar, yet she happily pays for books for all her grandchildren. The family calls her ______, and they mean it kindly.»
1. Значение: бережно относится к деньгам.
2. Отношение: она охотно тратит на книги, и семья говорит это по-доброму: положительное.
3. Сравните: thrifty (+) подходит. У stingy (−) верное значение, но не то отношение.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «In her review of the school play, Mahliyo praised the ______ performance of the lead actor: in the final scene he spoke with complete calm and certainty, never once glancing at the prompter, and the audience believed every word.»
1. Значение: спокойный и уверенный.
2. Отношение: она его похвалила, значит, положительное.
3. Какой вариант и уверенный, и положительный?

body.en:
Watch out: the strongest word is rarely the right one.
SAT texts are often careful. A study that "hints at" an answer has not "settled" it; a reader with doubts about a plan is "doubtful", not "hostile".
A second trap: an advanced word you only half know. Do not choose a word because it sounds impressive. Decide on the options you are sure of first, then judge the rest.
Test: would the writer of this calm, careful text use a word this strong?
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: eng kuchli soʻz kamdan-kam hollarda toʻgʻri boʻladi.
SAT matnlari koʻpincha ehtiyotkor. Javobga «hints at» (ishora qiladigan) tadqiqot uni «settled» (hal qilgan) emas; reja haqida shubhasi bor oʻquvchi «doubtful» (shubhada), «hostile» (dushmanona) emas.
Ikkinchi tuzoq: yarim-yorti biladigan murakkab soʻz. Soʻzni chiroyli eshitilgani uchun tanlamang. Avval aniq biladigan variantlaringiz haqida qaror qiling, keyin qolganini baholang.
Sinov: shu xotirjam, ehtiyotkor matn muallifi bunchalik kuchli soʻzni ishlatarmidi?
body.ru:
Осторожно: самое сильное слово редко оказывается верным.
Тексты SAT часто осторожны. Исследование, которое «hints at» (намекает на) ответ, его не «settled» (не решило); читатель, сомневающийся в плане, — «doubtful» (сомневающийся), а не «hostile» (враждебный).
Вторая ловушка: сложное слово, которое вы знаете наполовину. Не выбирайте слово только потому, что оно звучит солидно. Сначала разберитесь с вариантами, в которых уверены, а потом оцените остальные.
Проверка: стал бы автор этого спокойного, осторожного текста использовать такое сильное слово?

title.en: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose: the job of one sentence
title.uz: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — bitta gapning matndagi vazifasi
title.ru: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — роль одного предложения в тексте

body.en:
Lesson 1 asked what the whole text does. Now the question points at one sentence: "Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?"
Three steps:
1. Read the sentence before it and the sentence after it.
2. Ask: what would the text lose without this sentence? A reason? An example? A turn?
3. Name its job in a few words, then find the option that names the same job.
Common jobs of one sentence: introduces the topic, gives an example of a claim, explains a cause, adds a contrast or an exception, presents a solution, states the result or the conclusion.
Example: "Our garden club grew too many tomatoes. Last August, members picked forty kilograms in one week. So the club now gives its extra tomatoes to the canteen." The second sentence gives evidence for the claim in the first.
body.uz:
1-darsda butun matn nima qilishini soʻradik. Endi savol bitta gapni koʻrsatadi: «Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?» (ikkinchi gapning butun matndagi vazifasi qanday?)
Uch qadam:
1. Undan oldingi va keyingi gapni oʻqing.
2. Oʻzingizdan soʻrang: bu gap boʻlmasa, matn nimani yoʻqotadi? Sababnimi? Misolnimi? Burilishnimi?
3. Uning vazifasini bir necha soʻz bilan ayting, keyin xuddi shu vazifani aytgan variantni toping.
Bitta gapning koʻp uchraydigan vazifalari: mavzuni tanishtiradi, daʼvoga misol keltiradi, sababni tushuntiradi, qarama-qarshilik yoki istisno qoʻshadi, yechim taklif qiladi, natija yoki xulosani aytadi.
Misol: «Our garden club grew too many tomatoes. Last August, members picked forty kilograms in one week. So the club now gives its extra tomatoes to the canteen.» Ikkinchi gap birinchi gapdagi daʼvoga dalil beradi.
body.ru:
В уроке 1 мы спрашивали, что делает весь текст. Теперь вопрос указывает на одно предложение: «Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?» (какова роль второго предложения во всём тексте?)
Три шага:
1. Прочитайте предложение до него и после него.
2. Спросите: что потеряет текст без этого предложения? Причину? Пример? Поворот?
3. Назовите его роль в нескольких словах и найдите вариант, где названа та же роль.
Частые роли одного предложения: вводит тему, приводит пример к утверждению, объясняет причину, добавляет контраст или исключение, предлагает решение, сообщает результат или вывод.
Пример: «Our garden club grew too many tomatoes. Last August, members picked forty kilograms in one week. So the club now gives its extra tomatoes to the canteen.» Второе предложение подтверждает утверждение из первого фактом.

body.en:
Worked example: "The school canteen used to throw away a lot of bread. Then the cooks began baking two smaller batches, one in the morning and one at noon. Now almost no bread is wasted."
Without the second sentence, we would not know why the waste stopped. Its job: it describes the change that solved the problem in the first sentence.
Now you: "Many people in the building where Javlon lives used to leave their bicycles in the narrow entrance hall, where they blocked the stairs. Last spring, the residents cleared a corner of the yard and put up a simple metal rack. Now the hall is empty, and the bicycles stand in a neat row outside."
Sentence 1: a problem. Sentence 3: the result. What is the job of sentence 2?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The school canteen used to throw away a lot of bread. Then the cooks began baking two smaller batches, one in the morning and one at noon. Now almost no bread is wasted.»
Ikkinchi gap boʻlmasa, isrof nega toʻxtaganini bilmas edik. Uning vazifasi: birinchi gapdagi muammoni hal qilgan oʻzgarishni tasvirlaydi.
Endi siz: «Many people in the building where Javlon lives used to leave their bicycles in the narrow entrance hall, where they blocked the stairs. Last spring, the residents cleared a corner of the yard and put up a simple metal rack. Now the hall is empty, and the bicycles stand in a neat row outside.»
1-gap: muammo. 3-gap: natija. 2-gapning vazifasi nima?
body.ru:
Разбор: «The school canteen used to throw away a lot of bread. Then the cooks began baking two smaller batches, one in the morning and one at noon. Now almost no bread is wasted.»
Без второго предложения мы бы не знали, почему хлеб перестали выбрасывать. Его роль: оно описывает перемену, которая решила проблему из первого предложения.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Many people in the building where Javlon lives used to leave their bicycles in the narrow entrance hall, where they blocked the stairs. Last spring, the residents cleared a corner of the yard and put up a simple metal rack. Now the hall is empty, and the bicycles stand in a neat row outside.»
Предложение 1: проблема. Предложение 3: результат. Какова роль предложения 2?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
1. What a sentence says is not what it does. An option can repeat the sentence's content ("It mentions a metal rack") without naming its job. The question asks for the job.
2. The neighbor's job. An option can describe the sentence before or after the one the question names. Check every option against that sentence only.
Test: start with "This sentence …" and add the option's verb: "This sentence gives an example of …". Does it fit this sentence, and only this one?
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
1. Gap nima deyishi — uning vazifasi emas. Variant gapning mazmunini takrorlashi mumkin («It mentions a metal rack»), lekin vazifasini aytmaydi. Savol esa vazifani soʻraydi.
2. Qoʻshni gapning vazifasi. Variant savol koʻrsatgan gapdan oldingi yoki keyingi gapni tasvirlashi mumkin. Har bir variantni faqat oʻsha gap bilan tekshiring.
Sinov: «This sentence …» deb boshlang va variantdagi feʼlni qoʻshing: «This sentence gives an example of …». Bu aynan shu gapga mosmi, faqat shungami?
body.ru:
Осторожно, две ловушки.
1. Что предложение говорит — это не то, что оно делает. Вариант может повторять содержание («It mentions a metal rack»), не называя роли. А в вопросе спрашивают о роли.
2. Роль соседа. Вариант может описывать предложение до или после того, о котором спрашивают. Проверяйте каждый вариант только по этому предложению.
Проверка: начните с «This sentence …» и добавьте глагол варианта: «This sentence gives an example of …». Подходит ли это к этому предложению, и только к нему?

title.en: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose: texts that turn
title.uz: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — burilishli matnlar: fikr, keyin eʼtiroz
title.ru: SAT R&W: Text Structure and Purpose — тексты с поворотом: мнение, затем возражение

body.en:
Many SAT texts turn: they give one view, then a challenge, a limit or a surprise. Questions ask for the overall structure ("Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?") or the main purpose.
Three steps:
1. Find the turn: however, but, yet, in fact, actually, until recently.
2. Say the text in two parts: "first …, then …", for example "a common belief, then evidence against it".
3. Choose the verb as carefully as the topic:
• describe: says what something is like and takes no side
• explain: says why or how
• argue: takes a side and gives reasons
• challenge: says that a view is wrong
• qualify: says that a view is true only in part
body.uz:
Koʻp SAT matnlarida burilish boʻladi: avval bir fikr, keyin eʼtiroz, cheklov yoki kutilmagan holat. Savollar umumiy tuzilishni («Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?») yoki asosiy maqsadni soʻraydi.
Uch qadam:
1. Burilishni toping: however, but, yet, in fact, actually, until recently.
2. Matnni ikki qismda ayting: «avval …, keyin …», masalan, «keng tarqalgan fikr, keyin unga qarshi dalil».
3. Feʼlni mavzu kabi diqqat bilan tanlang:
• describe: biror narsa qandayligini aytadi, hech kimni yoqlamaydi
• explain: nega yoki qanday ekanini aytadi
• argue: bir tomonni oladi va sabab keltiradi
• challenge: fikr notoʻgʻri deydi
• qualify: fikr faqat qisman toʻgʻri deydi
body.ru:
Многие тексты SAT делают поворот: сначала одно мнение, затем возражение, ограничение или неожиданность. Вопросы бывают об общей структуре («Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?») или о главной цели.
Три шага:
1. Найдите поворот: however, but, yet, in fact, actually, until recently.
2. Перескажите текст в двух частях: «сначала …, затем …», например «распространённое мнение, затем довод против него».
3. Выбирайте глагол так же внимательно, как тему:
• describe: говорит, каково что-то, и не занимает сторону
• explain: говорит, почему или как
• argue: занимает сторону и приводит доводы
• challenge: говорит, что мнение неверно
• qualify: говорит, что мнение верно лишь отчасти

body.en:
Worked example: "Many people think that school lunch can be healthy or tasty, but not both. The new menu in our canteen shows otherwise: its vegetable soup is now the first dish to sell out every day."
Part 1: a common view. Part 2: an example against it. Verb: challenge. Not "describe" (the text takes a side), and not "argue that lunch should be free" (that is not in the text).
Now you: "Some people in the town where Yusuf lives think that the new cycle lane on Main Street is a waste of space, since few people cycled there before it was built. Counts made by students from the local school tell a different story: in the first month of the lane, the number of cyclists on the street each morning rose from about ten to more than sixty."
Part 1: what view? Part 2: what does it do to that view? Which verb fits?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Many people think that school lunch can be healthy or tasty, but not both. The new menu in our canteen shows otherwise: its vegetable soup is now the first dish to sell out every day.»
1-qism: keng tarqalgan fikr. 2-qism: unga qarshi misol. Feʼl: challenge (rad etadi). «Describe» emas (matn bir tomonni oladi), «argue that lunch should be free» ham emas (bu matnda yoʻq).
Endi siz: «Some people in the town where Yusuf lives think that the new cycle lane on Main Street is a waste of space, since few people cycled there before it was built. Counts made by students from the local school tell a different story: in the first month of the lane, the number of cyclists on the street each morning rose from about ten to more than sixty.»
1-qism: qanday fikr? 2-qism: u bu fikrga nima qiladi? Qaysi feʼl mos?
body.ru:
Разбор: «Many people think that school lunch can be healthy or tasty, but not both. The new menu in our canteen shows otherwise: its vegetable soup is now the first dish to sell out every day.»
Часть 1: распространённое мнение. Часть 2: пример против него. Глагол: challenge (оспаривает). Не «describe» (текст занимает сторону) и не «argue that lunch should be free» (этого в тексте нет).
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Some people in the town where Yusuf lives think that the new cycle lane on Main Street is a waste of space, since few people cycled there before it was built. Counts made by students from the local school tell a different story: in the first month of the lane, the number of cyclists on the street each morning rose from about ten to more than sixty.»
Часть 1: какое мнение? Часть 2: что она делает с этим мнением? Какой глагол подходит?

body.en:
Watch out: half right is wrong.
A structure option has two halves. Often the first half is right and the second is not: "presents a view, then supports it" when the text in fact questions it. Check both halves against the text.
Watch the strength of the verb, too. Qualify is not reject: if the text says a view holds only in some cases, an option saying that the text "proves the view false" goes too far.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: yarim toʻgʻri — notoʻgʻri.
Tuzilish haqidagi variant ikki yarimdan iborat. Koʻpincha birinchi yarmi toʻgʻri, ikkinchisi esa yoʻq: matn aslida fikrga shubha bildirsa ham, variant «presents a view, then supports it» deydi. Ikkala yarmini ham matn bilan tekshiring.
Feʼlning kuchiga ham qarang. Qualify (cheklash) reject (rad etish) emas: matn fikr faqat baʼzi hollarda toʻgʻri desa, «proves the view false» degan variant haddan oshadi.
body.ru:
Осторожно: наполовину верно — значит неверно.
Вариант о структуре состоит из двух половин. Часто первая верна, а вторая нет: «presents a view, then supports it», хотя текст на самом деле в нём сомневается. Проверяйте обе половины по тексту.
Следите и за силой глагола. Qualify (уточнить) — не reject (отвергнуть): если текст говорит, что мнение верно лишь в некоторых случаях, вариант «proves the view false» заходит слишком далеко.

stem.en:
Sherzod expected the science test to be difficult, since the last one had taken him the whole hour. This time, however, the questions were ______, and he finished with twenty minutes to spare.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: straightforward
confusing
lengthy
unfair

why.en: 'This time, however' turns against the hard last test, and he finished early: the questions were 'straightforward'. 'Confusing' and 'lengthy' go the old way.
why.uz: «This time, however» oldingi qiyin testga zid buradi, u erta tugatdi: savollar «straightforward» (oddiy) edi. «Confusing» va «lengthy» eski yoʻnalishda.
why.ru: «This time, however» поворачивает против трудного прошлого теста, и он закончил рано: вопросы были «straightforward» (простые). «Confusing» и «lengthy» описывают тест как прошлый.

stem.en:
The website of the hotel showed bright, spacious rooms with a view of the mountains. When the Rashidov family arrived, however, their room was ______: two narrow beds filled it almost completely, and the only window faced a brick wall.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: cramped
roomy
luxurious
peaceful

why.en: 'However' turns against 'bright, spacious', and two beds filled the room: it was 'cramped'. 'Roomy' and 'luxurious' repeat the website's promise.
why.uz: «However» «bright, spacious» ga zid buradi, ikki karavot xonani toʻldirgan: xona «cramped» (tor) edi. «Roomy» va «luxurious» saytdagi vaʼdani takrorlaydi.
why.ru: «However» поворачивает против «bright, spacious», две кровати заняли всю комнату: она «cramped» (тесная). «Roomy» и «luxurious» повторяют обещание сайта.

stem.en:
Nodira had practiced the piano piece every day for weeks, so on the evening of the school concert she was hardly ______; she walked onto the stage smiling and played the whole piece without a single mistake.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: nervous
calm
confident
prepared

why.en: She practiced for weeks and smiled on stage, and 'hardly' flips the blank: she was hardly 'nervous'. Hardly 'calm' or 'confident' would contradict her smile.
why.uz: U haftalab mashq qilgan va sahnada jilmaygan, «hardly» esa boʻsh joyni teskari qiladi: u deyarli «nervous» (hayajonda) emas edi. «Hardly calm» yoki «hardly confident» esa jilmayishiga zid.
why.ru: Она занималась неделями и улыбалась на сцене, а «hardly» переворачивает пропуск: она почти не была «nervous» (взволнована). А «hardly calm» или «hardly confident» спорили бы с её улыбкой.

stem.en:
The town council had planned to repaint the school fence this spring, but the budget ran a little short, and the work was moved to the autumn. Parents were ______ by the delay, though most agreed that a few extra months would make no real difference.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: slightly disappointed
deeply shocked
openly furious
quietly delighted

why.en: A short delay that makes 'no real difference' takes a mild word: 'slightly disappointed'. 'Deeply shocked' and 'openly furious' are far too strong.
why.uz: Deyarli farq qilmaydigan («no real difference») qisqa kechikish yumshoq soʻzni talab qiladi: «slightly disappointed». «Deeply shocked» va «openly furious» juda kuchli.
why.ru: Короткой задержке, которая почти ничего не меняет («no real difference»), подходит мягкое слово: «slightly disappointed». «Deeply shocked» и «openly furious» слишком сильны.

stem.en:
In her review of the school play, Mahliyo praised the ______ performance of the lead actor: in the final scene he spoke with complete calm and certainty, never once glancing at the prompter, and the audience believed every word.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: assured
arrogant
hesitant
careless

why.en: Calm, certain and praised: 'assured'. 'Arrogant' is also certain but negative, which does not fit praise; 'hesitant' fights 'certainty'.
why.uz: Xotirjam, ishonchli va maqtalgan: «assured». «Arrogant» ham ishonchli, lekin salbiy, maqtovga mos emas; «hesitant» «certainty» ga zid.
why.ru: Спокойно, уверенно, и это похвалили: «assured». «Arrogant» тоже про уверенность, но с негативной окраской и к похвале не подходит; «hesitant» спорит с «certainty».

stem.en:
After testing a homemade fertilizer on six pots of beans for one month, the school biology club was careful in its report. The results, the club wrote, ______ that the fertilizer helps beans grow, but more pots and a longer test would be needed before anyone relied on it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

options.en: suggest
prove
guarantee
deny

why.en: A small, careful test that needs more work only 'suggests'; it does not 'prove' or 'guarantee'. 'Deny' fights 'helps beans grow'.
why.uz: Qoʻshimcha ish talab qiladigan kichik, ehtiyotkor sinov faqat taxmin qiladi («suggest»), «prove» (isbotlaydi) yoki «guarantee» (kafolatlaydi) emas. «Deny» «helps beans grow» ga zid.
why.ru: Результаты небольшого осторожного опыта, который ещё надо продолжить, лишь «suggest» (указывают), а не «prove» и не «guarantee». «Deny» противоречит «helps beans grow».

stem.en:
The bus to Gulnoza's school is often late in winter. On the coldest morning of last January, it arrived forty minutes after the time on the timetable. Gulnoza now leaves home with a book, so the wait does not feel wasted.

Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?

options.en: It gives an example that supports the claim made in the first sentence.
It describes how Gulnoza deals with the late bus.
It questions whether the timetable is accurate.
It explains why the bus is late in winter.

why.en: Sentence 1 says the bus is often late; sentence 2 gives one late morning: an example that supports the claim. The book is the job of sentence 3.
why.uz: 1-gap avtobus tez-tez kechikishini aytadi, 2-gap bitta kechikkan tongni keltiradi: daʼvoni tasdiqlovchi misol. Kitob haqida esa 3-gap aytadi.
why.ru: Предложение 1: автобус часто опаздывает; предложение 2 описывает одно такое утро — это пример в поддержку утверждения. О книге говорится в предложении 3.

stem.en:
Many people in the building where Javlon lives used to leave their bicycles in the narrow entrance hall, where they blocked the stairs. Last spring, the residents cleared a corner of the yard and put up a simple metal rack. Now the hall is empty, and the bicycles stand in a neat row outside.

Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?

options.en: It describes the action that solved the problem presented in the first sentence.
It gives an example of the problem described in the first sentence.
It explains why the residents owned so many bicycles.
It states the result of the change described in the third sentence.

why.en: Sentence 1: bicycles block the stairs. Sentence 2: the residents put up a rack. Sentence 3: the hall is empty. So sentence 2 is the action that solved the problem.
why.uz: 1-gap: velosipedlar zinani toʻsadi. 2-gap: aholi velosiped turargohi qoʻyadi. 3-gap: dahliz boʻsh. Demak, 2-gap muammoni hal qilgan harakat.
why.ru: 1: велосипеды загораживают лестницу. 2: жильцы ставят стойку. 3: холл пуст. Значит, 2-е предложение — действие, которое решило проблему.

stem.en:
Shahzoda's grandfather keeps a notebook of the weather in his village. Every morning for thirty years, he has written down the temperature and whether it rained. Last winter, a teacher at the village school used his notes to show her class how to draw a graph of a year's weather.

Which choice best describes the function of the second sentence in the text as a whole?

options.en: It describes what the grandfather records in his notebook.
It shows how a teacher later used the grandfather's notes.
It reports the temperature on one cold winter morning.
It argues that every village should keep weather records.

why.en: Sentence 2 tells what goes into the notebook from sentence 1. How the teacher used the notes is the job of sentence 3: the neighbor trap.
why.uz: 2-gap 1-gapdagi daftarga nima yozilishini aytadi. Oʻqituvchi yozuvlardan qanday foydalangani 3-gapning vazifasi: qoʻshni gap tuzogʻi.
why.ru: Предложение 2 рассказывает, что дедушка записывает в тетрадь, о которой говорится в предложении 1. Как учительница использовала записи — роль предложения 3: ловушка соседа.

stem.en:
Many of Sevara's classmates believed that the oldest computer room in the school was useless, since its machines were too slow for games or video. Sevara, however, found a use for it: she started a coding club there, and the slow machines are perfectly fine for writing and testing simple programs. The club now has thirty members.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.en: It presents a common opinion about a room, then describes how one student showed that the room had value.
It describes how a computer room was built, then explains why its machines became slow.
It compares two computer rooms, then recommends one of them.
It presents a problem with a computer room, then explains how the school replaced its machines.

why.en: Part 1: classmates think the room is useless. Part 2: Sevara finds a use for it. A common opinion, then a student showing that the room had value.
why.uz: 1-qism: sinfdoshlar xonani foydasiz deb biladi. 2-qism: Sevara undan foydalanish yoʻlini topadi. Umumiy fikr, keyin xona foydali ekanini koʻrsatgan oʻquvchi.
why.ru: Часть 1: одноклассники считают компьютерный класс бесполезным. Часть 2: Севара находит ему применение. Общее мнение, затем ученица, показавшая ценность класса.

stem.en:
Some people in the town where Yusuf lives think that the new cycle lane on Main Street is a waste of space, since few people cycled there before it was built. Counts made by students from the local school tell a different story: in the first month of the lane, the number of cyclists on the street each morning rose from about ten to more than sixty.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.en: To challenge a view of the cycle lane by presenting new counts
To describe how the cycle lane was built
To explain why few people cycled before the lane existed
To argue that every street in the town should have a cycle lane

why.en: Part 1 is a view: the lane is a waste. Part 2, 'a different story', gives counts against it. The text challenges the view; it never argues for every street.
why.uz: 1-qism fikr: yoʻlak behuda. 2-qism, «a different story», unga qarshi sanoqlarni beradi. Matn fikrni rad etadi, har bir koʻchada yoʻlak boʻlishi kerak, deb daʼvo qilmaydi.
why.ru: Часть 1 — мнение: дорожка бесполезна. Часть 2, «a different story», даёт подсчёты против. Текст оспаривает мнение и не призывает к дорожкам везде.

stem.en:
A poster in Dilfuza's classroom says that music with words makes it harder to concentrate. When the students in her class tested the idea, they found that it held for reading tasks, where most of them scored lower with songs playing. For maths drills, however, the songs made almost no difference.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.en: It presents a claim, then reports a test showing that the claim holds only for some tasks.
It presents a claim, then reports a test showing that the claim is entirely false.
It presents a claim, then reports a test that fully confirms it.
It describes how the students chose their songs, then explains why they prefer maths drills.

why.en: The claim held for reading but not for maths: the test shows it holds only for some tasks. 'Entirely false' and 'fully confirms' are each half right.
why.uz: Daʼvo oʻqishda toʻgʻri chiqdi, matematikada esa yoʻq: sinov u faqat baʼzi topshiriqlarda toʻgʻri ekanini koʻrsatadi. «Entirely false» va «fully confirms» yarim toʻgʻri.
why.ru: Утверждение подтвердилось для чтения, но не для математики: оно верно лишь для части заданий. «Entirely false» и «fully confirms» верны наполовину.
